Question
========
You render an HTML report and want to email just the single `.html` file to your instructor as a homework submission.
Which YAML option should you add to make sure all images and plots are embedded directly in that file, rather than
referenced externally?

Answerlist
----------
* `toc: true`
* `code-fold: true`
* `embed-resources: true`
* `number-sections: true`

Solution
========

Answerlist
----------
* Wrong: `toc` adds a table of contents; it has no effect on whether resources are embedded.
* Wrong: `code-fold` controls whether code is collapsible; it has no effect on whether resources are embedded.
* Correct: `embed-resources: true` embeds all supporting files, such as images and plots, directly into a single, portable `.html` file.
* Wrong: `number-sections` adds section numbering; it has no effect on whether resources are embedded.
